t: Macrovision:  The Copy Protection in VHS

q.x: There was also apparently another method which was just a straight up lie, called KTC, that claimed it was coated with a chemical that would destroy any VHS recorder attempting to record it.

recs.x:
There was also apparently another method which was just a straight up lie, called KTC, that claimed it was coated with a chemical that would destroy any VHS recorder attempting to record it. Here's a screenshot of the pre-video bumper warning, alerting you to "STOP RECORDING NOW" [2]. Also any RedLetterMedia fans may remember this from the "dog sitting" video in Wheel of the Worst #7 (around 35:00 in). It sounds like a phony technology, and it is. It's just a lie intended to scare away anyone attempting to record the tape.
